name: Terminal Terror
summary:
In Terminal Terror, you find yourself alone at a desolate bus stop in the dead of night, waiting for your bus.

As the minutes tick by, an eerie silence envelops the scene, broken only by distant, unidentifiable sounds.

Suddenly, strange and unexpected occurrences begin to unfold, and your sense of reality starts to warp.

Will you catch your bus — or will you become another lost soul in the night?
